issues.problem_zh: 题面只暗示 crawl_async 要并行抓取，但页面自己的检查断言了同时在途数 > 1。
issues.change_zh: 第一句写明：crawl_async 要像 Part 2 一样让 get_urls 调用重叠进行（而不是一次只抓取一个页面），并保证同时在途的调用最多 concurrency 个。英文版同样修改。

checked: ran page (both languages), three times in a row to see whether the timing assertions are stable
followed the Part 1 trace by hand against the statement's rules; the example output is asserted by the page for all three implementations

compared crawl against an independent reachability computation on 1500 random graphs (mixed-case hosts, ports, userinfo, https, subdomains, fragments incl. empty and double '#', duplicate links, self-links, failing pages incl. a failing start page, start URL carrying a fragment), with exactly-once fetch counts

crawl_concurrent and crawl_async on 500 of those graphs each with limits 1, 2, 5, 16 (2000 runs each): same result, every URL fetched exactly once, peak in-flight calls never above the limit, no thread left alive afterwards
300-page complete graph with zero latency and 32 workers (maximum contention on the visited check), 5 trials each: no URL fetched twice
5000-page chain: crawl_async finishes without recursion problems
verified explanation claims: urlparse lower-cases hostname and ignores port/scheme, Queue's unfinished counter (put +1, task_done -1), asyncio.gather propagates the first exception immediately
compared Chinese prose with English paragraph by paragraph; python blocks identical in both files
